question_intents: How to operate and monitor the Qursor AGV via the HMI interface
data.summary: This user guide details the Qursor AGV HMI application, covering access methods via web or touch-screen and the management of operation modes such as Automatic, Manual, and Setup. It provides instructions for manual vehicle control, monitoring safety scanners and battery status, and managing faults, network connectivity, and RFID identification features.
